image_style_prefix: Clean stylised 3D CGI explainer render, realistic proportions, bright soft even studio lighting, light blue-grey palette, glossy surfaces, gentle floor reflections.
image_prompt_guard: Square 1:1 composition. One single large subject, centred and filling most of the frame, on a plain seamless background. All surfaces plain and unmarked.
image_car_guard: The car has a smooth, seamless, completely blank front and rear fascia and bumpers.
video_motion: Smooth, slow camera move; clean animated 3D explainer style; the key element animates clearly (e.g. a gauge filling, a slider moving, a part glowing). No text, no captions, no logos.
video_negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, brand badge, emblem, watermark, wall charger, distorted car, extra wheels, flicker
